stem: (Select TWO.) Cobalt Logistics wants to run `terraform validate` inside a CI job with no backend configured and no cloud credentials supplied. Which two statements describe what the command actually needs and does?

choices.text: validate needs a fully configured backend so it can check remote state consistency
validate requires the same provider credentials as a live deployment, to check attribute values
validate needs an initialized working directory with the referenced plugins and modules installed
validate cannot run at all until after the configuration has already been deployed once
validate runs without a working backend or live credentials

rationale: validate needs plugins and modules installed so it can check attribute names and types, which is what an initialized directory provides; it does not need a working backend or live credentials to do that. Claiming it needs a full backend for remote state consistency contradicts its own stated scope. It does not require the same credentials as a live deployment, since it never contacts the remote account. It also does not require a prior deployment; it can run on a configuration that has never been applied.
